description: The direction of a fill that does not need the fill-handle drag (WCAG 2.5.7 Dragging Movements). Down copies the leading row of the selection downwards (Ctrl+D, Fill down), Right copies the leading column rightwards (Ctrl+R, Fill right); both run the same AutoFillCommand as the pointer drag, so a keyboard or single-pointer fill is one undo step. The fill-handle drag stays the fast path on a coarse pointer.
